description: This file contains implementation of test classes and methods for disk cache testing in Chromium, including cache initialization, cleanup, iteration, and crash simulation.

classes.name: DiskCacheTest
classes.description: Base class for disk cache tests, manages temporary directory and cache path.

classes.name: DiskCacheTestWithCache
classes.description: Derived class providing cache initialization, iteration, and crash simulation functionalities for testing disk cache behavior.

classes.name: DiskCacheTestWithCache::TestIterator
classes.description: Helper class to iterate over cache entries during tests.

methods.name: DiskCacheTest::CopyTestCache
methods.description: Copies test cache data from source directory to cache directory.

methods.name: DiskCacheTestWithCache::InitCache
methods.description: Initializes cache either in memory or on disk.

methods.name: DiskCacheTestWithCache::SimulateCrash
methods.description: Simulates a crash by flushing and clearing cache, then recreates backend.

methods.name: DiskCacheTestWithCache::CreateBackend
methods.description: Creates cache backend with specified flags, supports simple and disk cache modes.
